heading: Interested in scheduling appointments? Or just have a question?
intro: Fill out the form below, call, or send an email — whatever's easiest. I aim to return calls and messages within 48 business hours.

steps.title: Reach Out
steps.text: Send a message, call, or email to ask about availability and whether we're a good fit.

steps.title: Schedule a Consultation
steps.text: We'll set up a time to talk through what brings you to therapy and answer any questions you have.

steps.title: Begin Your Sessions
steps.text: Start meeting regularly in a space built around your goals, your story, and your pace.

crisisNote: This form is not a secure or monitored line for emergencies. If you are experiencing a mental health crisis, please call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) or go to your nearest emergency room.
